questions.stem: A 68-year-old female presents with a new-onset severe headache, scalp tenderness, and jaw pain while chewing. Laboratory investigations reveal ESR 85 mm/hr, CRP 45 mg/L, and mild normochromic anemia. A biopsy of the temporal artery shows panarteritis with inflammatory mononuclear cell infiltrates and giant cell formation. In the analysis of T cells from the arterial lesion, which cytokines are primarily produced and play a crucial role in disease progression?
